detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

Thymosin Alpha-1

Chemical Information:
  • Molecular Formula: C129H215N33O55
  • Molecular Weight: 3108.28 g/mol
  • Sequence:Ac-Ser-Asp-Ala-Ala-Val-Asp-Thr-Ser-Ser-Glu-Ile-Thr-Thr-Lys-Asp-Leu-Lys-Glu-Lys-Lys-Glu-Val-Glu-Glu-Glu-Ala-Glu-Asn-OH
  • Molecular Structure:
Product Description:

Thymosin Alpha-1 is a peptide fragment derived from prothymosin alpha and is commonly utilized in biochemical and molecular research involving peptide–receptor interactions and signaling pathway analysis. In controlled laboratory settings, Thymosin Alpha-1 is studied for its role in peptide-associated signaling mechanisms, intracellular pathway analysis, and structure-function characterization under defined in vitro conditions. This material is supplied in lyophilized powder form and is intended strictly for in vitro research and analytical applications.

Research Applications:

 

Thymosin Alpha-1 is utilized in controlled research environments to support investigation of:

  • Peptide–receptor interaction dynamics in signaling pathway models
  • Intracellular signaling cascade analysis associated with peptide ligands
  • Structure-function relationships of thymic-derived peptide sequences
  • Cellular interaction modeling in controlled experimental systems
  • Stability, degradation, and analytical profiling in assay-based environments

All research applications are conducted in non-human, non-clinical experimental settings.

Storage and Handling:
  • Store lyophilized material at −20°C (−4°F)
  • After reconstitution, store at 2–8°C (36–46°F) and use promptly
  • Avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles
  • Maintain aseptic laboratory handling procedures
Product Specifications:
  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  • Appearance: Lyophilized white powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in suitable laboratory agents
Compliance Notice:

Thymosin Alpha-1 is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
